methodology: Curated BSC Agent-ID Mint/claim projects from cited official pages and clearly labeled third-party research. Fee claim is not proof of current availability, safety, eligibility, or transaction success. No wallet transactions performed.

opportunities.name: AGENT — Agent ID Holder Mint
opportunities.announcedCost: Mint is described as free, plus BNB gas
opportunities.descriptionZh: 针对 .ai Agent ID 持有者的代币铸造页面，自称每个符合资格的 Agent ID 可铸造 9,000 AGENT。是否仍开放、资格与合约安全尚未独立核验。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Token mint site for .ai Agent ID holders; claims 9,000 AGENT per eligible ID. Current availability and contract safety unverified.

opportunities.name: BN World — Onchain Agents
opportunities.announcedCost: First 2 per eligible wallet advertised as free
opportunities.descriptionZh: 项目页面称持有 Binance Agent ID 的钱包前两次 Mint 免费，但页面也提示铸造尚未开启。当前状态须重新核验。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Site advertises the first two mints free for eligible Agent ID wallets, but states mint is not open yet. Recheck before participating.

opportunities.name: BNB Agent Studio — Limited Free Experience
opportunities.announcedCost: Limited free experience described in official announcement
opportunities.descriptionZh: BNB Chain 官方文章介绍过限时 AWS 免费体验，额度可能已用完。不是免费 NFT Mint。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Official BNB Chain article described a limited free deployment experience; availability may have expired. Not an NFT mint.

opportunities.name: Agentlings · 像素特工
opportunities.announcedCost: 首铸 1 个免费（另付 BNB Gas）；后续盲盒 0.004 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Agentlings 是 BSC 上的 AI Agent 像素宠物 NFT。持有 .ai Agent ID 的钱包据称可免费铸造一只；宠物可揭晓稀有度并通过合成升级。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Agent-only pixel pets on BSC; one first mint free per Agent ID, followed by paid mystery boxes.

opportunities.name: Robo Agentic · 机器人 NFT
opportunities.announcedCost: 每个 Agent ID 首个免费（另付 Gas）；后续 0.0005–0.002 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Robo Agentic 是 5,000 枚 AI 机器人形象的 NFT 系列。网站设置 1,000 个免费名额，每个 .ai ID 可免费领取一个；之后采用四级 BNB 价格梯度。
opportunities.descriptionEn: 5,000 robot portraits with a claimed one-per-ID free allocation and paid tiers.

opportunities.name: Agent Periodic Lab · 元素实验室
opportunities.announcedCost: 每个 .ai 身份首张化合物卡免费（Gas 另付）；其余抽卡页面标价 0.00368 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Agent Periodic Lab 是 BSC 链上元素合成游戏：先领取化合物卡，再收集元素、尝试配方并放入反应堆获取 LAB。官网称首铸免费，额外抽卡收费。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Onchain chemistry card game for Agent IDs; first compound free, paid element draws and a reactor.

opportunities.name: AnthroBit · Agent 卡牌经济
opportunities.announcedCost: 每天首铸免 Mint 费，但仍需支付预言机随机数费和 Gas；其他 0.002–0.026 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: AnthroBit 提供可训练、融合和交易的 Bits 卡牌，设计了竞技属性及交易费分享机制。官网写明每日首铸不收 Mint 费，但预言机 VRF 和 Gas 费用仍需支付。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Agent-native card creatures with training and fusion. First mint each UTC day waives mint fee, but oracle and gas fees remain.

opportunities.name: Agent Panda · 熊猫卡牌
opportunities.announcedCost: 每个 Agent ID 前 2 张免费（Gas 另付），后 2 张 0.001 BNB/张
opportunities.descriptionZh: Agent Panda 是 BSC 熊猫卡牌 NFT，带有质押与 APANDA 代币相关玩法。公开链上参与记录显示同一 Agent ID 钱包有两张免费额度，另外两张需要付费；代币流动性不可预设。
opportunities.descriptionEn: BNB Chain panda NFT cards with two claimed free mints, additional paid slots and a separate staking mechanism.

opportunities.name: BSC Agent · Fragment 碎片
opportunities.announcedCost: 首张 Fragment 免费（Gas 另付），之后 0.001–0.005 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: BSC Agent 是 Fragment 卡牌铸造、质押和 5 合 1 Core 融合玩法。研究记录显示持有 .ai Agent ID 的钱包首张碎片免费，后续按次数阶梯付费。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Agent-ID-gated Fragment NFTs, staking and 5-to-1 fusion, with a free first mint followed by paid tiers.

opportunities.name: Pandaroo · 链上熊猫 SVG
opportunities.announcedCost: 每钱包前 3 张免费（Gas 另付），后续约 0.00005 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Pandaroo 是 7,777 枚 BSC 链上 SVG 熊猫 NFT，设计了 7,000 枚免费配额，持有 Agent ID 的钱包前 3 张据记录免 Mint 费。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Onchain SVG panda NFTs for Agent-ID holders, with a free initial allowance and tiny paid mints.

opportunities.name: Dandelio · 蒲公英 SVG
opportunities.announcedCost: 每钱包前 3 张免费（Gas 另付），后续约 0.00005 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Dandelio 是 BNB Chain 上的 6,666 枚 SVG 蒲公英主题 NFT，采用 Agent ID 门槛与分段免费额度；后续可按微额 BNB 铸造。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Agent ID-gated generative SVG dandelion collection with a free initial allowance.

opportunities.name: Aurora Bots · 极光机器人
opportunities.announcedCost: 每钱包首张免费（Gas 另付），后续约 0.0005 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Aurora Bots 是 BSC 机器人主题链上生成式 NFT，共设计 20,000 枚，其中首批 7,777 枚为免费配额；每个 Agent ID 钱包首张据公开研究记录免费。
opportunities.descriptionEn: 20,000 generative robot NFTs on BSC, with a limited free allocation per Agent ID.

opportunities.name: Pulse Titans · 泰坦生成艺术
opportunities.announcedCost: 前 2,888 个免费配额中，每钱包最多 4 张免 Mint 费；超出后 0.01 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Pulse Titans 是 10,000 枚 BSC 链上生成式 NFT。早期规则包含 2,888 个免费名额和每钱包至多 4 张；配额可能已用完，必须查最新合约状态。
opportunities.descriptionEn: 10,000 generative NFTs with an earlier free allocation; remaining free quota may have ended.

opportunities.name: Tampesta · 风暴谜题 NFT
opportunities.announcedCost: 解开风暴谜题可免费铸造最多 2 张（另付 Gas）；免答题铸造 0.0042 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Tampesta 是 Ombrello 团队的 2,222 枚像素风暴 NFT，仅限 Agent ID 钱包。免费通道需要完成网站谜题领取一次性凭证，跳过谜题则需要支付 BNB。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Agent-only pixel-storm NFTs: solve a puzzle for a gas-only mint or pay 0.0042 BNB instantly.

opportunities.name: BOO · 链上万圣节
opportunities.announcedCost: 每钱包首张免费（另付 Gas）；之后费用以合约 priceFor 为准
opportunities.descriptionZh: BOO 是 BNB Chain 上的 3,110 枚万圣节主题 Agent ID 专属 NFT。官网称每钱包第一张免费，稀有度会在铸造期结束后使用未来区块哈希统一揭晓。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Halloween-themed onchain NFT collection with free first mint and a later reveal.

opportunities.name: Agent Shaniu · SHANIU 领取
opportunities.announcedCost: Agent ID 持有者领取 SHANIU 不收代币购买价（Gas 另付）
opportunities.descriptionZh: Agent Shaniu 在 BSC 上提供面向 .ai Agent ID 的 SHANIU 领取及链上订单簿玩法。领取数量依规则随机；是否仍有剩余额度需以合约读取为准。
opportunities.descriptionEn: BSC meme-token claim for Agent-ID wallets, with a random onchain claim amount and order-book trading.

opportunities.name: agent币 · Agent Genesis
opportunities.announcedCost: 每钱包首张 NFT 免费（Gas 另付；需 PoW 计算）
opportunities.descriptionZh: agent币 是 BSC 上要求持有 .ai Agent ID 的 NFT 铸造项目。官网给出免 Mint 费的首张领取路线，需先计算 PoW nonce 再执行合约调用。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Agent-ID-gated NFT claim that uses a proof-of-work nonce for the first free mint.

opportunities.name: Abyssagent · 深渊特工
opportunities.announcedCost: 资料称每钱包前 2 张免费（另付 Gas），之后每张 0.000069 BNB
opportunities.descriptionZh: Abyssagent 是 4,444 枚 BSC Agent ID 专属 NFT，第三方索引描述每钱包前两次免 Mint 费，其余付费；目前保留公开研究来源。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Agent-ID-only NFT collection with a reported initial two-free-mint allowance.

opportunities.name: NEXUS CORE II · 神经核心
opportunities.announcedCost: 首张 0.0003 BNB，第二至第五张各 0.001 BNB（另付 Gas）
opportunities.descriptionZh: NEXUS CORE II 是 3,333 枚 BSC 链上神经核心 SVG NFT，面向 .ai Agent ID 持有者。全部为付费铸造，研究索引显示首张低价、后续固定费率。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Paid onchain neural-core SVG collection with an Agent ID mint gate and small BNB prices.

opportunities.name: ASH · BSC 固定价代币铸造
opportunities.announcedCost: 每份 0.003 BNB，按来源声称可得 32,000 ASH；每钱包最多 10 份
opportunities.descriptionZh: ASH 是 BSC 的固定价格代币铸造项目，每份计划提供 32,000 ASH；转账在铸造结束前受限。公开资料指出网站统计和链上数量可能不一致，参与前要自行确认合约。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Paid BSC token mint, 0.003 BNB per 32,000 ASH share, with transfers restricted until finalization.

opportunities.name: OK AGENT · 复古电脑 NFT
opportunities.announcedCost: 早期免费配额已用完，付费价格为动态阶梯；需查询当前合约金额
opportunities.descriptionZh: OK AGENT 是复古电脑像素头像 NFT，面向 .ai Agent ID 钱包。公开链上资料显示最初的 3,000 个免费额度已领完，剩余改为阶梯付费。
opportunities.descriptionEn: Retro computer-style Agent-ID NFT series whose early free quota has ended; paid prices are dynamic.

opportunities.name: METEORA AGENTS · 纯链上宇宙 NFT
opportunities.announcedCost: 最早 122 张免费额度已用完；后续收费规则见来源合约
opportunities.descriptionZh: METEORA AGENTS 是 1,222 枚 BSC 太空角色 NFT，图片以 SVG 形式由链上合约生成。开发者公开称最早的免费额度已用完，当前属于付费铸造；没有承诺代币回报。
opportunities.descriptionEn: 1,222 fully onchain SVG space-agent NFTs. The initial free allocation is gone and remaining mints are paid.
